Membership facts for all named roles (Priya, Olena, Lukas, Robert, Mateo membership in C_INFRA; Incognito only in C_GROWTH) are already present in the supplied base_seed, and the still-to-be-added reaction rows are permissible planned additions at this design stage per the review rules. The obligation (channel_members, mode multiple, target_roles the three qualifying memberships) and answer_attributes (channel_id, user_id, joined_at — all bare columns) faithfully mirror the request. The access_plan (conversations.history → reactions.get → conversations.members) uses only documented API operations and no hidden IDs. The only concern is a minor realism nit (Priya reacting to her own message), which does not undermine construction validity.
